BashMenu-RS

API & Crate Documentation · GitHub Repository

Core Libraries

  • bashmenu_core — YAML configuration, Serde schemas, macro interpolation, i18n, and plugins.
  • bashmenu_tui — Ratatui widgets, borders, drop-shadow modals, pickers, and theme styling.

CLI Applications

  • bashmenu — Main terminal menu system and interactive Markdown runner.
  • bmpager — Native terminal pager with CommonMark, inline images, and OSC 8 hyperlinks.
  • bashedit — Standalone Unicode text editor with colocated swap files.
  • menuedit — Visual menu tree editor for bashmenu.mnu.
  • shortcutedit — Keyboard shortcut editor for shortcuts.yml.
  • themeedit — Visual split-screen theme editor with 2D color and ASCII pickers.
  • cheat — Interactive cheatsheet search and viewer.
  • ymlcheck — YAML configuration and locale schema validator.
